name: Needle of Softening
body:
Price 3,500 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 11; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This needle is made of precious metal. When jabbed into a creature who has been petrified, the needle absorbs into their body and the target is returned to their natural form.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,750 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells stone to flesh
